dismissals.reason: The ClosedAndRegenerated section intentionally consumes the explicit durable coordinator.close_and_regenerate / fixer.close_and_regenerate event contract (constants added in internal/eventlog/eventlog.go), with the event producers owned by the #462/#464 regeneration workflows as documented in the PR body. Emitting a producer here would duplicate that work and expand scope beyond issue #466 (the digest), so the request is declined per the PR's documented trade-off rather than implemented in this PR.
